description:
Wrap everything up and prove it.

1. @behaviour OctoPi.Agent.Transport:
     @callback stream(Model.t(), Context.t(), StreamOptions.t()) :: Enumerable.t(Event.t())
   Default impl OctoPi.Agent.Transport.Direct delegates to
   OctoPi.AI.stream/3 from Phase 1. Session opts accept
   :transport (module) with Direct as default. Proxy impl deferred.

2. Port the critical tests from pi-mono/packages/agent/test/:
   - agent-loop.test.ts: event order, exit conditions, tool-result
     append order, sequential mode honored, hook block/patch
   - agent.test.ts: state setter copy semantics, subscribe
     unsubscribe closure, :sync listener ordering, abort mid-stream
     surfaces :aborted, steer injection, follow_up idle behaviour

3. Live integration test (gated :integration tag):
   - Register an Echo tool
   - OctoPi.Agent.start_session + prompt "repeat 'hello' via echo tool"
   - Watch events flow until agent_end with :stop
   - Verify messages list contains user → assistant(tool_use) →
     tool_result(echo) → assistant(stop)

4. mix agent.demo task (optional but nice): like ai.demo but at the
   agent layer — register Echo tool, run a prompt, print events.

Depends on z1d.4, z1d.5, z1d.6, z1d.7.
title: Transport behaviour + live integration + port pi-mono tests
